config.enabled.tooltip: Let Automate harvest ready crops into connected chests.
config.xp.tooltip: Award the same Farming experience a manual harvest would give. Turn off if you'd rather automation didn't level you up.
config.replant.tooltip: After harvesting a crop that doesn't regrow, plant a fresh seed from the connected chests if there's a suitable one.
config.types.tooltip: Only crops whose produce is one of the ticked types get picked. Anything unticked is left standing in the field.
config.types.forage.tooltip: Crops that produce a forage item, such as Fiber and Cotton Boll.
config.types.seeds.tooltip: Crops whose produce is itself a seed, such as Sesame Seeds or Soybeans.
config.types.other.tooltip: Anything that fits none of the types above — often produce added by other mods.
